meta.name: FIFA+
meta.description:
Bringing fans into the heart of football with the iconic World Cup Archive, Live football from around the globe and documentaries bring the stories behind the beautiful game.

Shows: A Look Back, Italy v Brazil | Group C | FIFA Women's World Cup France 2019™ | Full Match Replay, France v Germany | Group A | FIFA Women's World Cup Germany 2011™ | Full Match Replay, IR Iran v USA | Group B | FIFA World Cup Qatar 2022™ | Full Match Replay, Sweden v USA | Group C | FIFA Women's World Cup Germany 2011™ | Full Match Replay
Available on: Samsung TV Plus
